ck_addresses_owner.name: ck_addresses_owner
ck_addresses_owner.value: "addresses"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "addresses"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL

ck_gardens_owner.name: ck_gardens_owner
ck_gardens_owner.value: "gardens"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "gardens"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL

ck_invoices_credit_link.name: ck_invoices_credit_link
ck_invoices_credit_link.value: ("invoices"."kind" = 'CREDIT_NOTE' AND "invoices"."original_invoice_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("invoices"."kind" = 'INVOICE' AND "invoices"."original_invoice_id" IS NULL)

ck_quotes_duration.name: ck_quotes_duration
ck_quotes_duration.value: ("quotes"."recommended_half_days" IS NULL OR "quotes"."recommended_half_days" >= 1) AND ("quotes"."selected_half_days" IS NULL OR "quotes"."selected_half_days" >= 1)

ck_quotes_amounts.name: ck_quotes_amounts
ck_quotes_amounts.value: ("quotes"."subtotal_ht_cents" IS NULL OR "quotes"."subtotal_ht_cents" >= 0) AND ("quotes"."vat_cents" IS NULL OR "quotes"."vat_cents" >= 0) AND ("quotes"."total_ttc_cents" IS NULL OR "quotes"."total_ttc_cents" >= 0)

ck_schedule_reservations_target.name: ck_schedule_reservations_target
ck_schedule_reservations_target.value: "schedule_reservations"."quote_id" IS NOT NULL OR "schedule_reservations"."order_id" IS NOT NULL OR "schedule_reservations"."kind" = 'BLOCK'

ck_stored_files_parent.name: ck_stored_files_parent
ck_stored_files_parent.value: "stored_files"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "stored_files"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL OR "stored_files"."order_id" IS NOT NULL OR "stored_files"."intervention_id" IS NOT NULL OR "stored_files"."invoice_id" IS NOT NULL
